name: taskcraft
description: taskcraft L2: one binary for the CLI (every verb takes --json) and the MCP stdio server.

tools.name: task_status
tools.description: Tracker status: counts (open, in progress, urgent, overdue), projects, demo flag.

tools.name: task_project_create
tools.description: Create a project with a 2-10 char key (issues become KEY-n). Optional repo_path enables git sync.

tools.name: task_issue_list
tools.description: List issues, urgent first. Finished issues are hidden unless include_finished or an explicit status filter.

tools.name: task_issue_show
tools.description: One issue with relations, open blockers, linked commits and full history.

tools.name: task_issue_update
tools.description: Change fields. Pass null to clear estimate/assignee/milestone/due_date. labels replaces the set.

tools.name: task_issue_move
tools.description: Change status. Moving to in_progress/in_review/done is refused while an open issue blocks it, unless force=true.

tools.name: task_relation_add
tools.description: Relate two issues. 'blocks' edges may not form a cycle.

tools.name: task_milestone_create
tools.description: Create a milestone in a project.

tools.name: task_milestone_list
tools.description: Milestones with progress (issues and points done/total).

tools.name: task_board
tools.description: Kanban lanes for a project: cards per status, points, blocked flags.

tools.name: task_git_sync
tools.description: Read the project repo's git log, link commits mentioning KEY-n, close issues on 'closes/fixes/resolves KEY-n'. Needs --allow-path covering the repo.

tools.name: task_inbox_drain
tools.description: Turn events from other craft apps (deskcraft ticket.escalated, contractcraft contract.deadline) into issues; teamcraft capacity.changed is stored per week and shown in task_status.

tools.name: task_demo_seed
tools.description: Fill an EMPTY tracker with a labelled demo project.
